name: What factors should I consider when choosing a garage renovation contractor?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a garage renovation contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, consider their experience with similar projects, their licensing and insurance, client references, and their communication style. It's also important to ensure they have a clear understanding of local building codes and permitting requirements in your specific Bay Area city. Requesting detailed proposals and contracts is also advisable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, references, communication, and knowledge of local building codes and permits.
